steps.note: Configure the tenant’s DoA threshold currency to INR and verify the setting through the product.

args.goal: as the Tenant Admin, open Modular Approval Setup, make approvals attachable to entities including events, onboarding, purchase orders, payments and letters of credit, then open the Delegation of Authority matrix and stop on the spend-threshold definitions showing INR as their currency unit

steps.note: Perform the approval setup and observe the behavior controlled by the currency setting.
Assert that the DoA threshold matrix visibly shows INR.
